summary.en: The traditional Japanese flower ball, glued: a square folded on its diagonal, its corners brought up into a diamond and rolled into a cone makes a petal; five petals make a flower and twelve flowers make the ball.
summary.es: La tradicional bola de flores japonesa, pegada: un cuadrado doblado por la diagonal, con las esquinas subidas en un rombo y enrollado en cono, forma un pétalo; cinco pétalos forman una flor y doce flores forman la bola.
summary.fr: La boule de fleurs japonaise traditionnelle, collée : un carré plié sur sa diagonale, ses coins remontés en losange puis roulé en cône, donne un pétale ; cinq pétales font une fleur et douze fleurs font la boule.
summary.pt: A tradicional bola de flores japonesa, colada: um quadrado dobrado na diagonal, com os cantos levados para cima num losango e enrolado em cone, faz uma pétala; cinco pétalas fazem uma flor e doze flores fazem a bola.

era: traditional Japanese paper folding; paper flower balls of undocumented date, in continuous use

note.en: The geometry is original MADFAM work (a single-vertex petal rolled into a faceted cone, the flower and the ball solved from contact conditions); the glued flower ball and its credit belong to the Japanese paper-folding tradition.
note.es: La geometría es obra original de MADFAM (un pétalo de un solo vértice enrollado en un cono facetado, y la flor y la bola resueltas a partir de las condiciones de contacto); la bola de flores pegadas y su crédito pertenecen a la tradición japonesa del plegado de papel.
note.fr: La géométrie est une œuvre originale de MADFAM (un pétale à un seul sommet roulé en cône à facettes, la fleur et la boule résolues à partir des conditions de contact) ; la boule de fleurs collées et son crédit appartiennent à la tradition japonaise du pliage de papier.
note.pt: A geometria é obra original da MADFAM (uma pétala de um só vértice enrolada num cone facetado, e a flor e a bola resolvidas a partir das condições de contato); a bola de flores coladas e o seu crédito pertencem à tradição japonesa da dobradura de papel.

excludes: Modular kusudama whose units slot into pockets, and every designer's modular unit: only the traditional glued petal is modelled
Sewn or threaded kusudama, tassels and hanging threads: described in the sources, not modelled
The assembly motions (petals into a flower, flowers into the ball): the flower and the ball start assembled
